chosen.title: artist drawing a human brain
chosen.why: Hand, paper, pen only; steady top-down close-up of a hand hatching a hand-drawn brain diagram with a ballpoint pen (matches 'doctor drawing diagram'). Continuous small stroke motion across 17.0-20.4s. No text, logo or watermark. Downsides: flat neutral/cool white light rather than warm desk light (needs a warm grade), and the pen is a fairly saturated blue.

alternates.why: Best tonal match: warm window light, shallow depth of field, film-like low saturation, hand with pencil, sleeve visible. But it is a canvas on an easel rather than paper on a desk and the drawing motion is very subtle (lines barely visible).
Extreme close-up of a pencil sketching hair on paper, warm skin tones and visible drawing motion, but handheld, jittery and frequently out of focus; last resort only.

notes: Seven searches run; 'sketch pencil paper' and 'doctor drawing diagram' returned nothing, 'drawing with pen on paper' returned only a digital-tablet clip (48519, rejected: tablet + watch). 101389 (woman sketching in notepad) had no downloadable file. 24580 (writing in a paper notebook) was rejected because printed planner text and the written word are legible. Calligraphy set (5069x-5071x) rejected for saturated green cutting mats and legible words. Recommend warming 9339 by ~+15 temperature and lowering saturation to tame the blue pen; center crop unnecessary (16:9 source).
